### Request to Replace a Phytosanitary Certificate

The trader asks for this certificate to be replaced. {{ if eq (print .ephyto_country) "non_ephyto" }}If you accept, the trader amends the NPQS application, and you then issue the replacement certificate. The importing country is not an ePhyto country, so nothing is sent through the IPPC ePhyto Hub.{{ else }}If you accept, the trader amends the NPQS application and adds a note; you then issue the replacement certificate and send it to the IPPC ePhyto Hub as a replacement for this one.{{ end }} If you reject it, the certificate stands and the trader is told your remarks.

- **Reference Number**: `{{ .reference_number }}`
- **Certificate Number**: `{{ .certificate_id }}`
{{ if .tracking_number }}- **Hub Tracking Number**: `{{ .tracking_number }}`
{{ end }}{{ if .tracking_info }}- **IPPC Hub Status**: `{{ .tracking_info }}`
{{ end }}
